sloka: तव लक्ष्मण जानामि मयि स्नेहमनुत्तमम् ।विक्रमम् चैव सत्यम् च तेजश्च सुदुरासदम् ॥२-२१-३८॥
transliteration: tava lakṣmaṇa jānāmi mayi snehamanuttamam ।vikramam caiva satyam ca tejaśca sudurāsadam ॥2-21-38॥

translations.english: I know, O Lakshmana, your profound affection for me. I also know your valour, strength and unassailable energy.
